notes.title: Version 1.1.1 release
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed a bug where enemy bullets couldn't be erased by exploding the player's shield.
Fixed a bug where scraps could not be absorbed if the player's arm was out of the screen when absorbing scraps.

notes.title: Version 1.1 release
notes.notes:
Steam Leaderboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40823705/822aebb7e9d5a50ec6c3801bea87c24a5d6f440b.png
To upload the leaderboard, turn on "Upload Score" from the options on the title.
Turn it on, it will be auto uploaded to the Steam leaderboard when the score is updated.
Upload Score is set to ON by default.
If you do not want to upload the leaderboard, set it to OFF.
You can check the leaderboard in "Community Hub"-> "View Stats"-> "Global Leaderboards".
The score before the leaderboard implementation is not uploaded, so it may be different from the high score in the game.
There are 24 types of leaderboards.

Other changes

Added tutorial text.
